mechanism: Dealers pre-hedge customer orders for the WM/Reuters 16:00 London benchmark fix (window 15:57:30-16:02:30), so large one-sided fix flow pushes price in the 30 min before and into the fix; that is temporary price pressure from non-discretionary benchmark-tied orders (asset managers, index rebalancing, corporates), and documented post-fix partial reversal follows once the flow is done (Evans 2018; Melvin & Prins 2015; Krohn et al. 2022). Different from Section A: event-timed, ~1 trade/day, and conditioned on a large flow-driven move, so the expected snap-back is several pips. Consistent with finding 2 (short-horizon moves reverse).
